<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>AA 입력 도우미</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:"Monapo";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");}
:root{--bg:#fff;--fg:#1a1a1a;--card:#f2f2f4;--line:#d0d0d6;--accent:#2f6fed;--accent-fg:#fff;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#16161a;--fg:#ececf0;--card:#24242b;--line:#3a3a44;--accent:#6b97ff;--accent-fg:#101014}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#16161a;--fg:#ececf0;--card:#24242b;--line:#3a3a44;--accent:#6b97ff;--accent-fg:#101014}
html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif}
main{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px}
h1{font-size:18px;margin:4px 0 10px}
#ed{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;height:46vh;font-family:"Monapo","MS PGothic","MS P Gothic","IPAMonaPGothic",sans-serif;font-size:11px;line-height:1.125;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%;
white-space:pre;overflow:auto;background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;resize:vertical}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:10px 0}
button{font:inherit;font-size:16px;min-width:48px;min-height:48px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg)}
button.p{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);border-color:var(--accent)}
details{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px;margin-top:10px}
#cfg{width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;height:110px;font:16px monospace;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:8px}
small{color:var(--fg);opacity:.7}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<main>
<h1>AA 입력 도우미</h1>
<textarea id="ed" placeholder="여기에 AA를 붙여넣고, 아래 버튼으로 기호를 넣으세요" spellcheck="false" autocapitalize="off" autocomplete="off"></textarea>
<div class="row" id="snips"></div>
<div class="row"><button id="fm">A−</button><button id="fp">A＋</button><small id="fs"></small></div>
<div class="row">
<button id="paste">붙여넣기</button>
<button id="copy" class="p">전체 복사</button>
<button id="clear">지우기</button>
</div>
<small id="msg">&nbsp;</small>
<details>
<summary>버튼 편집</summary>
<p><small>한 줄에 버튼 하나입니다. ㄱ+한자+1로 나오는 문자를 여기에 붙여넣으면 버튼이 됩니다.</small></p>
<textarea id="cfg" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
<div class="row"><button id="save" class="p">저장</button></div>
</details>
<p><small>폰트: Monapo (IPA Font License v1.0)</small></p>
</main>
<script>
var DEF="「\n」\n　\n※";
var ed=document.getElementById("ed"),cfg=document.getElementById("cfg"),box=document.getElementById("snips"),msg=document.getElementById("msg");
function say(t){msg.textContent=t;setTimeout(function(){msg.innerHTML="&nbsp;"},1800)}
function load(k,d){try{var v=localStorage.getItem(k);return v===null?d:v}catch(e){return d}}
function store(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(e){}}
function insert(s){
  var a=ed.selectionStart,b=ed.selectionEnd;
  ed.setRangeText(s,a,b,"end");
  ed.focus();store("draft",ed.value);
}
function render(){
  box.innerHTML="";
  cfg.value.split("\n").forEach(function(s){
    if(!s)return;
    var btn=document.createElement("button");
    btn.textContent=/^\u3000+$/.test(s)?"전각×7":(s.trim()===""?"공백":s);
    btn.addEventListener("pointerdown",function(e){e.preventDefault()});
    btn.addEventListener("click",function(){insert(/^\u3000+$/.test(s)?"\u3000".repeat(7):s)});
    box.appendChild(btn);
  });
}
var fs=parseInt(load("fs","11"),10)||11;
function setFs(n){fs=Math.max(7,Math.min(24,n));ed.style.fontSize=fs+"px";document.getElementById("fs").textContent="글자 "+fs+"px";store("fs",String(fs))}
document.getElementById("fm").onclick=function(){setFs(fs-1)};
document.getElementById("fp").onclick=function(){setFs(fs+1)};
setFs(fs);
cfg.value=load("snips",DEF);ed.value=load("draft","");render();
ed.addEventListener("input",function(){store("draft",ed.value)});
document.getElementById("save").onclick=function(){store("snips",cfg.value);render();say("저장했어요")};
document.getElementById("clear").onclick=function(){if(confirm("전체를 지울까요?")){ed.value="";store("draft","")}};
document.getElementById("copy").onclick=function(){
  ed.select();
  var p=navigator.clipboard&&navigator.clipboard.writeText?navigator.clipboard.writeText(ed.value):Promise.reject();
  p.then(function(){say("복사했어요")}).catch(function(){try{document.execCommand("copy");say("복사했어요")}catch(e){say("길게 눌러 복사하세요")}});
};
document.getElementById("paste").onclick=function(){
  if(!navigator.clipboard||!navigator.clipboard.readText){say("입력창을 길게 눌러 붙여넣으세요");return}
  navigator.clipboard.readText().then(function(t){insert(t)}).catch(function(){say("입력창을 길게 눌러 붙여넣으세요")});
};
</script>
</body>
</html>
